DiffDialog.SortingInsertedWarning: IMPORTANT: Mods were inserted into the middle of the load order. Sort the list first to move them to the end before making other changes.
DiffDialog.DependentChangesSummary_Generic: + {0} mod positions affected by this change
DiffDialog.InsertedWarningTooltip: This mod was inserted into the middle of the load order. Consider sorting the list first.
DiffDialog.AddedTooltip: This mod was added at the end of the load order. This is safe and won't affect existing mod positions.
DiffDialog.RemovedTooltip: This mod was removed from the load order. All subsequent mods shifted up, which can break save game references. Right-click for options.
DiffDialog.ReplacedTooltip: This mod was replaced at the same position. No other mods are affected — this is a safe change.
DiffDialog.MovedTooltip: This mod's position changed due to other modifications in the load order.
DiffDialog.GuidanceRemovalBody:
Removing a mod shifts all subsequent mod positions. Save games store references by position — shifted mods can cause missing items, broken quests, or crashes.

Recommendation: Right-click each removed mod and choose 'Replace with...' to substitute a placeholder mod. This preserves the positions of all mods below.
DiffDialog.GuidanceInsertionBody:
Mods inserted in the middle of the list shift all subsequent positions down. This has the same risks as removing a mod.

Recommendation: Click 'Fix Load Order' to sort the list. Sorting moves inserted mods to the end, restoring the original positions of existing mods.
DiffDialog.GuidanceReplacementBody: Replaced mods occupy the same position as the original. No other mods are shifted — this is a safe operation.
DiffDialog.GuidanceAddedBody: Mods added at the end of the load order do not affect existing positions. This is always safe.
DiffDialog.GuidanceMovedBody: These mods changed position due to other modifications in the load order. No action is needed — their new positions are a natural consequence of other changes.
DiffDialog.GuidanceNoChangesBody: The current load order matches the reference file.
